div.head: II Cn 5.1
div.ab: Þæt bið þæt man idol weorðige, hæþne godas ⁊ sunnan oððe monan, fyr oððe flod, wǽterwyllas oððe stanas oððe æniges cynnes wudutréowa, oððe wiccecræft lufie, oððe morðweorc gefremme on ænige wisan, oððe on blote oððe on fyrhte, oððe swylcra gedwímera ænig þing dreoge.

Namely, the worship of idols, heathen gods, and the sun or the moon, fire or water, springs or stones or any kind of forest trees, or indulgence in witchcraft, or the compassing of death in any way, either by sacrifice or by divination or by the practice of any such delusions.

Hæðenscipe byð, þæt man deofolgyld þæt is þæt man weorðige hæðene godas ⁊ sunnan oððe monan, fyr oððe flod, wæterwyllas oððe stanas oððe æniges cynnes wúdutreowa, oððon wiccecræft lufige oððon morðweorc gefremme on ænige wisan, oððon on blote oððon on fyrhte, oððon swylcra gedwimera ænig þíngc dreoge.
